brief:
Abdul El-Sayed defeated Republican Mike Rogers in Michigan's U.S. Senate race, Mondoweiss reported, contradicting media narratives that his positions on Israel had divided Democrats. El-Sayed, who will become the first Muslim U.S. Senator, won despite coverage suggesting his views created party fractures.

The outlet characterized ongoing media treatment of El-Sayed as reflecting Islamophobic bias, arguing that coverage remains disconnected from public sentiment that supported his candidacy.
dek: Abdul El-Sayed's victory over GOP candidate Mike Rogers laid waste to the media narrative that El-Sayed "divided" Democrats over Israel. Yet this obvious Islamophobic bias still dominates coverage of the first Muslim U.S. Senator.
title: El-Sayed's Senate win exposes media bias on Israel stance
